details.detail: Aisle vault: the arch between the bins, the 2-frame panel joints and the lit colour are right (render q06 (460,20) #ecebea against photo y_47301 (560,30) #f2f2f0). What is wrong is how the edges are fitted out. Every aisle in the model has a grille and a cove wash on BOTH edges. Each real aisle has them on ONE edge only (next item). The speaker panels are still octagonal (d_up, h_trough, g_latch).

Slatted grille and cove light: in every photo, each aisle has ONE slatted grille, and it always sits with the bright cove wash beside it (b_lalf_c119, b_sany_y10, b_sany_y12: against the outboard bin; y_47301, looking aft from the starboard aisle: against the centre bin). That pattern fits identical ceiling panels translated, not mirrored, into both aisles, so the grille is on the port edge of each aisle. The model draws two grilles and two lit edges per aisle (TROUGH.ts [0.10, 0.96] and MAT.led on both bin tops). The grille is also split into cells of about 0.27-0.35 m between solid cross bars (c119 crop, 3-4 per 2-frame panel), not 0.55 m runs. Up close the 13/9 mm stripe reads as piano keys (g_latch).

Outboard bins: 2-frame modules, with a latch and a row placard per module (c119: '15' then '14' on adjacent modules), a near-upright door and a single dark seam. The latch is about 13 % of the module width (py_37302 is about 12 %) and sits about 38 % down the door. All of this matches.

Centre bins: r2's colour issue is fixed (q16 (400,20) #c1c3c5 and q06 (200,40) #cdcfd1 against y_47301 (700,40) #c2c3c7 and c_27312 (200,60) #c3c7cb). The door still shades in flat, constant-value plateaus with hard steps (f_cbin x=150: #97999e for y 76-156, then #87898d for y 164-268, with no gradient), so it reads as three facets. The real door (c119 crop) is one smooth gradient. In q15 the door strip beside the channel is only a sliver (#c1c3c5..#cbcccf), where y_47300 shows broad bright doors (#f3f3f3). The q15 camera sits 0.39 m under the channel, which is partly to blame.
Latches: a recessed pill with a light rim and a dark slot, the right size and position. The c119 latches read slightly more cup-like (raised rim), which is minor.

Outboard PSU: the model hangs a near-square raised box (0.16 x 0.14 m) per bay. The photos show an elongated lozenge recess per window bay, running across the band, about 0.30 x 0.11 m, holding two round eyeball reading lights (b_lalf_c26 close-up; b_sanpy_13 and py_37302 show the same elongated pods). The filler-panel joints are about 0.27 m apart, not 0.18 m. The box is also not mirrored port and starboard: the gasper sits inboard on the right and outboard on the left.

Centre PSU channel: two slim transverse rows (a linked reading-light rail, then gaspers) at about 70 % of the channel width, which now matches y_47300. Channel tone q15 (460,20) #c1c1c0 against photo #bbbbbb..#c9c9c9. In THE Room the gaspers are in the seat shell (b_frugal_c_vents), yet the model still hangs ceiling gaspers over F/J seats.

No-smoking and seat-belt signs: the model draws a dark housing (#2a2e34) with icons on a black ground (#0c0f13). The real unit (b_lalf_c26 close-up) is a flush pill-shaped recess in the same light-grey band plastic. The icons are amber with red accents (a red no-smoking ring, a red arrow on the belt). Nothing on the unit is dark.
Row placards: small dark-grey numerals and seat icons printed straight on the door top (py_37302 '25 ..', c119 '15' / '14'). The model now matches this.

Ceiling EXIT signs: the bilingual '← 非常口 EXIT →' face and header position are in the code. None of this round's QA views shows them close enough to judge. c119 shows only a small red EXIT sign on the far bulkhead header.

Speaker and emergency light: the rounded-rect panel still renders octagonal. n = 24 uniform columns over w = 0.33 m leaves only about 2 columns per 30 mm corner. In c119 it is a perforated speaker grille with a raised rim, not a plain plate. The small emergency lens position (mid-vault) matches.
Door-area ceilings: cannot be judged this round. q01_door1 and q13_pyFront render with the camera inside a monument or partition, so the frames show a wall.

issues.detail: Each aisle vault has a slatted grille and a bright cove wash on both edges. In every photo, each aisle has only one grille, with the bright cove beside it.
issues.problem: Geometry and lighting layout. There are twice as many grilles and lit edges as in the real cabin, so the vault reads symmetric and over-lit.
issues.evidence: b_lalf_c119 (port aisle looking fwd): grille plus a #f6f6f6 cove wash against the outboard bin only; the centre-bin edge is a plain seam. b_sany_y10 and b_sany_y12 (looking aft; the grille is on the right, the port outboard side): same, with the centre-bin edge plain. y_47301 (starboard aisle looking aft): grille and bright wash against the centre bin, i.e. again on the port edge of the aisle. The model draws both (h_trough, d_up, q06 top).
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js buildCeilings: replace `for (const tg of TROUGH.ts)` with `for (const tg of [side < 0 ? TROUGH.ts[0] : TROUGH.ts[1]])`. That gives the port aisle a grille against the outboard bin (t 0.10) and the starboard aisle one against the centre bin (t 0.96). Also make eFn light only that edge. With `const tG = side < 0 ? 0.10 : 0.96, xG = lerp(VAULT_A[0], VAULT_B[0], tG)`, use `return 0.05 + 0.5*Math.exp(-Math.abs(ax - xG)/0.10) + 0.12*Math.exp(-Math.min(1.655-ax, ax-0.735)/0.10)`, which gives a faint wash on the unlit edge. 08_bins.js: keep the cove MAT.led only on the grille edges. In sideBinModule add it only when side < 0. In centerBinModule add it only for s = +1. Because sideBinModule is shared by instances, pass a flag. Move the speaker panel away from the grille: vaultPanel tc = side < 0 ? 0.78 : 0.22 (c119 has it on the centre side in the port aisle) [D, from translated identical panels].

issues.detail: The centre-bin doors shade as flat, constant-value bands with hard steps instead of a smooth gradient. They read as three facets.
issues.problem: Artefact (faceting or banding) on the most prominent surface in the Y and J views.
issues.evidence: f_cbin.png column x=150: #97999e is constant from y 76 to 156, then #87898d is constant from y 164 to 268. Column x=300: #e6e6e7 steps to #96999e at y 156 and to #88898e at y 220. c119 crop: the real door is one continuous gradient.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js: (1) shadeUpper uses step thresholds (ny -0.3 / 0.5 give jumps 0.97 -> 0.99 -> 1). Make it continuous: `const f = lerp(1.0, 0.95, clamp((0.5 - ny) / 1.5, 0, 1));`. (2) In addDoor raise the gExtrude smoothDeg from 25 to 45 so no neighbouring CR segments are split. (3) Re-render f_cbin. If the plateaus persist, the cause is the AO volume or shadow map, not normals. In that case offset the AO lookup further on these faces, or give BINMAT.doorC l: LAYER.plastic with a smaller roughness so the GGX term varies.

issues.detail: The outboard PSU is a square raised box. The real one is an elongated lozenge recess running across the band, with two round eyeball reading lights. It is not mirrored between the two sides.
issues.problem: Geometry and proportion. At the seat level this is the most visible ceiling fitting.
issues.evidence: b_lalf_c26 (THE Room window seat): a pill recess about 2.7:1 across the band, with two eyeball lights at about 1/3 and 2/3. b_sanpy_13 (PY) and py_37302: elongated transverse pods, one per window bay. Model: gRBox(0.16, 0.03, 0.14). psuXF only rotates it, so the gasper at local x -0.028 lands inboard on the right side and outboard on the left side.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js psuBoxModule: replace it with a lozenge. Housing gRBox(0.30, 0.018, 0.11, 0.05, 2) in BINMAT.psuBox. A dark-rim recess ring is the same box at 0.29 x 0.10 offset -0.0005 in BINMAT.o2gap. Two eyeballs: gCyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.006, 16) bezel in BINMAT.pod plus gCyl(0.018, 0.018, 0.012, 14) in MAT.lens at x = -0.07 and +0.06, y -0.022. Put the call and attendant light as a small gBox at x +0.12. Build it symmetric about x so no mirror is needed, or use mirrorGeo from 09_seats.js for the left side. In sideBinModule cut the band joints from 6 to 4 per module (k < 4, L/4), which gives about 0.27 m panels as in py_37302.

issues.detail: The no-smoking and seat-belt sign units are dark housings on a black ground. The real ones are flush pills in the light-grey band plastic, with amber icons and red accents.
issues.evidence: b_lalf_c26: a pill recess the colour of the band. The no-smoking icon is an amber cigarette in a red ring; the belt icon is two amber buckle halves and a red arrow. Model: signPod #2a2e34 and psuSigns ground #0c0f13 (visible as a dark slab in q15 centre channel and on the outboard bands in q16/q17).
issues.fix: 08_bins.js paintBinDecals psuSigns: set the ground to '#e1e0dc' and draw a pill outline stroke '#c9cac9'. Draw the cigarette in '#ffab2e' and its ring and slash in '#e8322a'. Draw the belt halves in '#ffa634' with a red '#e8322a' arrow between them. signPodModule: change the housing to gRBox(0.14, 0.006, 0.05, 0.025, 2) in BINMAT.psuBox, flush. Draw the face with {...MAT.decal, e: 0.12} instead of exitGlow e 0.6, so that only the saturated icons read as lit. Use the same material for the psuModule sign quad.

issues.detail: The rounded-rect speaker panel on each vault panel still renders as an octagon, and it is a plain plate instead of a perforated grille.
issues.problem: Faceting on the corners, and a missing surface detail.
issues.evidence: h_trough, g_latch and d_up: chamfered corners are clearly visible. vaultPanel spaces n = 24 columns evenly over 0.33 m, so each 30 mm corner gets about 2 columns. c119: a perforated speaker with a raised rim.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js vaultPanel: sample u non-uniformly. Take 8 points per corner, `u = ±(w/2 - r + r*Math.sin(j*Math.PI/16))` for j = 0..8, plus 2 on the straight part, and sort the list. Then compute h from that u as now. Give the inner layer (bezelIn) `l: LAYER.grille` (as BINMAT.grille uses) so that it reads perforated.

issues.detail: The grille runs are 0.55 m long with 5 cm bridges. The real grille is split into cells of about 0.27-0.35 m by thicker solid cross bars.
issues.evidence: b_lalf_c119 crop: cross bars about every 1/4-1/3 of a 2-frame panel. Vault joint arcs line up with a bar.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: TROUGH = { ts: [0.10, 0.96], w: 0.08, run: FRAME / 2, gap: 0.03 }. Start the za loop at each module boundary (mods[k]) so a bar lands on every vault joint.

issues.detail: F/J centre PSUs hang ceiling gaspers. THE Room has its gaspers in the seat shell.
issues.evidence: b_frugal_c_vents: two gasper nozzles on the THE Room shell panel under the light. b_lalf_c26: the ceiling units above the seat are round eyeball lights.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js psuModule(n, lights, pitch, gaspers = true): wrap the two gasper gCyls in `if (gaspers)`. In buildBins pass gaspers = !fj for the 'o' keys.

issues.detail: Two of the six QA views assigned to this area render the inside of a monument, so the door-area ceiling and the PY front ceiling cannot be rated.
issues.problem: QA harness camera placement, not the ceiling code. Raising it so the integrator can fix the view.
issues.evidence: q01_door1.png: a grey marble wall fills the frame. q13_pyFront.png: a beige partition covers the right 50 %.
issues.fix: test/qa.js: move q01 to walk(-0.6, 1.62, 5.4, 'Math.PI+0.12', -0.08), i.e. in the door-1 cross aisle. For q13 use __rel('25C', 0.35, 1.75, -0.6, ...) or set the camera clear of the PY front partition. Re-render both.

questionsForUser: Every photo shows only one slatted grille (with its bright cove wash) per aisle. In the port aisle it is against the outboard bin (c119, the SANspotter shots); in the starboard aisle it is against the centre bin (ANA's y_47301). I read that as identical ceiling panels repeated in both aisles. Do you have a photo from the starboard aisle looking forward to confirm it, or should I make it symmetric (grille against the outboard bins only)?
In THE Room, the gaspers are on the seat shell and the ceiling unit above has only reading lights. OK to remove the ceiling gaspers over F/J seats?
